about: Retrieval-quality set for the Sales Playbook knowledge space (REF S21). It measures required-evidence recall at k (did the top-k retrieved sections include every section listed in required_evidence, matched on filename and exact heading) and source selection (were the required sources among those the answer drew on and cited), plus answer correctness by deterministic token matching of expected_answer_facts (lowercase alphanumeric tokens; a fact is hit when its text or one alias appears). Out-of-scope rows pass when the answer says the playbook does not cover the question. Built on 2026-10-03 by reading all 17 approved sources in spaces/sales-playbook/core; a section is the passage under its nearest Markdown heading, written exactly as in the source and in the platform's extracted sections, including PDF-extraction artefact headings such as '1. Input guardrails check the question for manipulation, unsafe content and'. Every fact text is verbatim (case-insensitive, token-normalised) in its required section, and questions avoid copying headings or rare passage words where that stays unambiguous. Where another section repeats part of an answer, the notes say so and the facts are chosen from the required section. Labels were written before any run. Split rule: every id whose number is a multiple of three is holdout (11 answerable plus 2 out-of-scope); the rest are tuning.
